get.description: A versioned, read-only JSON export of BAFU observations, archived BAFU forecasts and SAPPHIRE forecasts for one or more eligible stations (Plan 198, extended by Plan 204). See docs/spec/forecast-lab-snapshot.md for the full contract — timestamp/quantile conventions, the F3 percentile-band sign correction, partial-vs-500 semantics, and offline-caching guidance. All responses are no-store. Omitted station_code selects eligible scoped stations; any unknown, ineligible or out-of-scope requested code rejects the whole request. This comparison view is not authoritative evaluation.

get.description: Forecast detail, with typed qc_flags. For an activated CHWRR tenant only selected or historical replaced publications expose values; an unpublished or out-of-scope ID is 404, a withdrawn ID is 410 with a metadata-only tombstone. All service roles use the same publication gate. A malformed forecast_id remains unguarded and returns 500, not 400.

404.description: Unknown or out-of-scope station/forecast — the same body either way (never reveals which).

get.description: Latest visible discharge observation per scoped station within an inclusive window ending at generated_at. All scoped stations count, including those without readings; UUID-sorted pages. Null means no visible reading in this window, not no history. A MISSING observation remains an object with null value and its QC status. No QC-pass filter or automatic freshness classification. measured_parameters describes station configuration; source selects one observation source. Consumer/reviewer delivery restrictions apply before latest selection; admin includes deliveries. All responses are no-store.

Both QC rule sets as the serving process resolves them now. REVIEW-gated: a reviewer or admin token only (403 for a consumer token). Without station_id: deployment-wide, no station data. With station_id: the observation rules for that station, with the thresholds ingest applies there merged in — an out-of-scope station is 404 for a reviewer token, an unknown one 404 for a reviewer or admin token, a malformed one 400.

get.description: Read-only STANDARD evaluation selection per parameter, with current/prior UTC-day member diagnostics. Reviewer/admin or granted human only. Disabled reads return 404 independently of scheduling. valid_at must be timezone-aware; future times never shift the logical issue day. Activated-tenant reviewer values, flag detail and detailed provenance are withheld for both sources. No alternate value URLs. All responses are no-store; unavailable scoped evidence returns 503.

get.description: Every QC-rejected member or group-station forecast for this station in the query window — never stored in `forecasts` (Plan 404 D1/D2). Admits a reviewer or admin service token, OR a named human with a current station `review` grant (403 for a consumer token). Where a tenant's publication gate (Plan 341) is active, a reviewer token's items are withheld: values and flag detail are null; admin and a granted human always see the full record. An out-of-scope or ungranted station is 404 for a reviewer/human, an unknown one 404 for a reviewer, admin or granted human, a malformed one 400.
